title: Wave propagation of a non-conservative compressible two-fluid model with different pressures
summary: This paper investigates the wave propagation for a non-conservative compressible two-fluid model with unequal pressures in R3. This model is novel and fundamentally distinct from the classical single-phase compressible Navier-Stokes equations proposed by Liu-Wang [28]. This work fills a significant gap, as prior results largely apply only to conservative or partially conservative systems with specific Green's function cancellations.
